file_name: GLNG - Greater Meridian Project Assets - third-party questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with the GLNG Participants, Westside and/or Mitsui.

Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if the GLNG Participants (GLNG Project), Westside and Mitsui (Greater Merdian Joint Venture) are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
If you are a customer of either the GLNG Project or the Greater Meridian Joint Venture, outline any concerns relating to accessing gas that may arise from the Acquisition.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
